description: Our new one-storey community hall has an 800 m2 building area and a design occupant load of 120 people. It is not sprinklered. We want one public exit at the front and no other exit, using staff to manage an evacuation. What would an alternative application need?

missing_info.field: owner or representative contact and property identification
risk assessment, mitigating measures, assumptions and supporting documents
missing_info.why: Alternative-path completeness items; request evidence rather than fabricate a professional conclusion.

gold.departure: One exit serves an occupied floor area with an occupant load above the single-exit allowance.

should_cite.why: Single-exit permission has an occupant-load ceiling as well as area and travel limits.

must_not_cite.why: The stated 120 occupants exceed the 60-person condition.

gold.engineering_reason: The stated occupancy, building size or dwelling count is outside the Division C exemption; applicable drawings require qualified registered professionals.
